headline: Fire at the Halifax Grain Elevator on Marginal Road
dek: Crews responded to flames in the facility's dust management system, about 135 feet above the ground.

facts.v: Halifax Grain Elevator property, 730 Marginal Road

body: Halifax Regional Fire & Emergency responded to a 911 call at approximately 7:15 p.m. after a report of visible flames at the Halifax Grain Elevator property at 730 Marginal Road.

Crews found an incident involving the facility's dust management system, approximately 135 feet above ground level. At its peak the incident required a three-alarm response, and resources were later reduced as the risk decreased. The city described it as complex because of the industrial infrastructure, the height of the work and a vessel alongside the facility.
Residents were asked to avoid the area. The origin and cause had not yet been determined.
